entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God of Affliction on Theros, governing disease, poison, medicine and aging; a healer and alchemist, mother of the Gorgons.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane Pharika governs as a laboratory.

entities.name: Gorgons
entities.description: Children of Pharika whose blood carries potent magic.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: Place where Pharika is primarily worshipped.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God of the Underworld with whom Pharika has a respectful relationship.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Underworld whose realm Pharika appreciates.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God of civilization who cautiously tolerates Pharika.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of civilization who cautiously tolerates Pharika.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of knowledge whose mysteries Pharika values.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God Pharika despises for bestowing wisdom on the unworthy.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God whose bounty Pharika reveres; her closest relationship.

entities.name: Cult of Frozen Faith
entities.description: Infamous mystery cult dedicated to Pharika involving petrification and resurrection.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event that left Pharika unable to influence disease or healing.

events.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Pharika unable to influence mortal diseases or healing.
events.quote: Pharika was affected by the Silence of the Gods
